developed_on: 2023 season only (scripts/research/props_full.py dev); 2024-25 run once with these rules
pass_bar: holdout 2024-25 mean CLV > 0 with one-sided game-clustered p < 0.05/3 = 0.0167, AND mean CLV > 0 in 2024 and in 2025 separately

rules.name: td_shop_early
rules.desc: Anytime-TD Yes at the Friday snapshot, allowed books only. p = 2023 early calibration map applied to the leave-one-out median implied prob of >=3 OTHER us books; bet the best-EV allowed book per player if 0.10 <= EV < 0.60 (EV >= 0.6 treated as stale/erroneous quotes). CLV = 2023 close calibration map on the close median implied prob.

rules.name: rec_shop_early
rules.desc: Player receptions O/U at the Friday snapshot, allowed books. p = leave-one-out median no-vig P of >=3 OTHER us books quoting the same point; best-EV side/book per player if EV >= 0.02.
rules.selection_note: picked from 5 markets x 2 snapshots x 3 sides x 5 thresholds of shop rules; the other markets were ~-1% CLV in dev

rules.name: open_model_thesis
rules.desc: Pros' thesis test: Tuesday-open O/U, all five markets pooled, open-information projection blended with the market (w=0.2 on the model, shift (1-w)c), best-EV allowed book/side per player-market if 0.12 <= EV < 0.5.
rules.note: 2023 open coverage is only 39 of 276 events, so dev power is very low; frozen as an explicit hypothesis test (best open config in dev, still not positive).
